purpose: Checked how original clinical classifications were converted into binary labels.
Excluded VUS and retained only benign/likely benign and pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants.
Confirmed that each tool was linked to the correct raw score and prediction columns.
Measured raw score availability, binary prediction availability, missing values and uncertain outputs per tool.
Updated prediction-label rules so tool-specific labels were converted consistently.
Recalculated accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, MCC and related metrics using cleaned predictions.
Recalculated LR+ and LR− with safer handling of zero cells and non-interpretable cases.
Manually inspected example variants representing TP, TN, FP, FN, missing scores, uncertain outputs and conflicting predictions.
